title: Map: Iranian Chokepoints Driving Up the Cost of Diesel
text:
The waters of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait have repeatedly been a site of conflict because of their importance to global trade and energy transport. During the Yom Kippur War between Egypt and Israel in 1973, Egyptian ships coordinated with Egypt’s allies in South Yemen to blockade oil tankers en route to Israel through the strait. - Brittanica

Do you remember that? Both times: lies. On day 12 of this war, the president said quote, “We won.” On day 14, Secretary Hegseth said Iran’s military was quote “destroyed.” Day 14. Five months later, we’re still bombing. Americans are still dying. Iran still has its uranium. The Strait of Hormuz is still closed. I challenge anyone to defend this.
